description: This file contains utility functions for parsing command-line arguments related to Vitest reports, loading reporting data, and formatting milliseconds for reporting purposes.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to Vitest reporting, allowing optional configuration for report path, limit, and config file.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest report JSON based on parsed arguments and a prefix, returning the JSON content.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric value in milliseconds into a string with specified decimal digits.
